summary: Fortress Credit Realty Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered private placement of 806,494 common shares across six share classes for gross proceeds of approximately $16.1 million, priced at the August 31, 2026 net asset value per share of the applicable class. Sales relied on Section 4(a)(2), Regulation D and/or Regulation S exemptions. Separately, the Company declared a $0.1540 per-share gross distribution on each class, payable October 1, 2026, net of servicing, management and performance fees, in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. No special-situation event; watch NAV marks and ongoing capital-raising pace.
